rateLimits.note: The API documentation: "rate limits on requests starting at 25/second" (a starting threshold, per account key as the page implies; not said whether higher tiers exist).

attribution.text: Jain A. et al., The Materials Project: A materials genome approach to accelerating materials innovation, APL Materials 1, 011002 (2013)

provenance.notes: Read 2026-11-10: the docs page "tips for large downloads" (rate limits starting at 25/second; repeated large queries should use a local copy) and "access-controlled data" (terms per data product on the Terms page; the mp-api client applies the terms accepted at registration; GNoME only for non-commercial use). The Terms and Cite pages (next-gen.materialsproject.org) answered a Cloudflare check and were not read: CC BY 4.0 for the core data comes from search-engine excerpts of the Cite and legacy Terms pages; GNoME and ELEMENTA data are CC BY-NC, so commercial, storage and redistribution stay unknown per product. Every call needs the account API key (X-API-KEY). The heavy-use contact is from this package's README, not re-read on the provider's pages. A third-party note claims 2000 requests/day; not on the provider's pages.
